about: Graphs whose style graph draws a picture on a box (editor spec §18: animated_image_shown), drawn the same by the plugin's core and by graph_svg.py. Each case is a note's gql blocks, each block a list of lines, and the view it is drawn in, if any (its name only: the whole graph is drawn, styled as that view is). For every case both give the same problems reading each style, the same boxes drawn with a picture and the property and value naming it, and, for every graph drawn, the same Graphviz source in each direction laid out, byte for byte: the room kept for each picture, a marked square at the top of its box. The expected answers are the core's, run live: packages/core/test/picture-parity.test.js holds graph_svg.py to the core on these cases, and tests/test_graph_svg_picture.py does the same from the Python side.

cases.name: a picture on every thing of a kind, one thing's own over its kind's, a value not text drawing none
a picture chosen for a view, drawn in that view and not in the whole graph
a picture with properties shown inline and a nudge: the square above the caption, the rows below the text
Pictures written wrong: each the same problem in both, and left out; the one written right drawn
